question: Can pair-moment complete-cover obligations choose one consequential higher-order query?
assumptions: Eight common-start runners; reference 0; threshold 1/8; equality valid; core [1,4,5]; J=[9/32,3/8].
input_contract: Supplied L, four singles and all six pair durations, plus speeds and J. Pair evaluation is separately charged; this exceeds the prior one-pair contract.
rule: Use 16 nonnegative exact-state masses, fixed total/singles/pairs, to minimize empty-state mass. Require exact primal and dual certificates.
If optimum positive, report pair-only success and do not request geometry.
Otherwise impose empty-state mass zero and minimize each of the four inclusive triple masses. Require exact primal/dual certificates for all four minima.
Choose the largest strictly positive forced triple minimum, ties by sorted physical speed triple. If no positive minimum, report no individually forced triple; do not retune.

Evaluate only that selected triple by intersecting its three blocking schedules; compare its exact duration (a valid upper bound) with the forced minimum. Preserve interval/phase evidence and cost counts.
If actual upper bound is below the minimum, rule out ALL abstract full-cover distributions matching pair totals and this bound; reoptimize minimum empty mass with that one upper bound.
If unrepaired, test only right endpoint 3/8, preserving singleton versus interval. No second query or window.
diagnostic_after_selection: Existing archived higher-order moments may be read for comparison and independent verifier may reconstruct all states on these THREE windows only. Never feed those data to selection. Preserve nonzero triple/four-way overlaps in doubling_112.
falsification: A selected triple whose physical duration is not below its forced covering minimum is a retained failure of strict-duration repair. No mandatory positive triple is also a retained failure. Pair-only positive controls do not validate escalation. Invalid exact LP certificates invalidate computation.
scope: Three named controls only; at most 3 baseline LPs, 8 cover triple LPs, 2 one-bound repair LPs, 2 selected geometric triple evaluations, 2 endpoints. No new speeds, broad scans, all-reference tests, alternate windows, +7/+9, outreach or main merge.
cost: Count LP solves, logical states, selected interval lists and intersection comparisons. Floating optimization may propose certificates only; acceptance requires exact rational primal/dual feasibility and equal objective. No uniform runtime claim.
status: Finite diagnostics OBSERVED/REPRODUCED; general implications HYPOTHESIS/proof candidates. No novelty, independent human certification, arbitrary-speed existence or new family coverage.
